leadText:
Nintendo Anime Channel was a free app for the Nintendo 3DS family of systems available from the Nintendo eShop, that provided access to a selection of based on Nintendo properties as well as other licensed series. The service was first announced during the January 14, 2015 Nintendo Direct and launched in Europe on February 13, 2015 and in & on February 14, 2015 .

The app launched with a selection of episodes from Pokémon, and , with the intention that the library of content would grow over time and episodes from season eight were added in May 2017 . The service closed on October 31, 2018 .

==Available Pokémon animation==
At the time of the service closure, the following series of Pokémon animation were available on the service :
Certain seasons of :
Indigo League (season 1)
Adventures on the Orange Islands (season 2)
Advanced (season 6)
Advanced Challenge (season 7)
Advanced Battle (season 8)
Pokémon Generations
